commands.checks: Exact live source/dependency/toolchain bindings, Lean declaration and axiom-request inventories, and source policy only. Does not run Lean or certify a mathematical theorem; use the dedicated workflow or full verify.py command.

Seven guard tests: nested-comment policy, axiom whitelist/completeness, preservation of unrecognized workspaces, read-only isolated optimized relocation, source corruption, exact Lean-version parsing during cold setup and missing axiom requests. Python guard validation only.
